title: Security and concurrency stamps issued
why: Shows that the identity store generates the identifiers and stamps the app depends on for sessions and optimistic concurrency.

steps.does: POST …/identity/register-user with a valid passenger (Email mei.tanaka@example.com, UserName mei.tanaka, PassPortNumber JP7788990, Password Str0ng!Pass1, matching ConfirmPassword), then read the saved User.

expect: Registration succeeds. The saved User has a new non-empty Id (uuid), a non-empty SecurityStamp, and a non-empty ConcurrencyStamp. The two stamps are different values.
